# GTM Skills (swan-gtm/gtm-skills): installed subset

Source: https://github.com/swan-gtm/gtm-skills at commit `5d786aa`, MIT licence (copyright 2026 Swan; each skill keeps its author). Collections as listed at https://www.gtmskills.com/collections on 23 October 2026. Installed unchanged into `.claude/skills/<skill>/` except the Swan-specific `swan.md` layers, which were left out. Scripts were reviewed; installing does not run them.

Subset: Outbound pipeline, Inbound pipeline, Deal acceleration. 58 skills installed. Not installed (no matching folder in the repo): `hyper-personalized-outreach`, `pre-meeting-briefing`, `business-case`. Not installed by choice: For GTM leaders, AI GTM transformation, ABM, Expansion, Events, Ads.
